title: Kissed Golden Dutch Mushroom Pilaf
description: A rich and light Dutch dish featuring HP sauce and mushrooms, perfect for a crowd, this ovo-vegetarian friendly pilaf is sure to please. It combines the flavors of mushrooms, onions, and HP sauce with a hint of deglazed goodness.
instructions: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat until melted.
Add chopped onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add HP sauce to the skillet and stir to combine, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Add rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the mushroom and onion mixture.
Add vegetable broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in beaten eggs.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
